Counsel for Applicant :- Suresh Kumar Gupta
Counsel for Opposite Party :- Ajay Kumar Mishra,G.A.
Hon'ble Vikram D. Chauhan,J.
1.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant, Sri Ajay Kumar Mishra, learned counsel for opposite party no.2 and learned AGA for the State.

2. This application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. has been filed by applicant for quashing the charge sheet dated 22.4.2022, under Sections 498A, 504 IPC and Section 3/4 D.P. Act, 1961, P.S. Mahila Thana, Kanpur Nagar arising out of FIR/Case Crime No.0038 of 2021 against applicant and entire proceedings of Case No.93472 of 2022 (CNR No.UPKN04-09560/2022) pending before learned Civil Judge (J.D.)F.T.C. (C.A.W.),Kanpur Nagar, under Sections 498A, 504 IPC and Section 3/4 D.P.
Act, 1961, P.S. Mahila Thana, Kanpur Nagar, District Southern (Commissionerate Kanpur Nagar),
Kanpur Nagar arising out of Case No.038 of 2021.
3. Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the parties have entered into a compromise.
4. Learned counsel for opposite party no.2 also submits that parties have settled their dispute and he would have no objection in case the present criminal proceedings are quashed.
